summary: Ansible 15 netapp.ontap changes: AWS Lambda support in modules such as na_ontap_active_directory, cg_snapshot, cli_timeout, ems_*, fdsd/fdsp/fdspt/fdss, fpolicy_*, kerberos_*, login_messages and nvme, and Google Cloud NetApp Volumes (GCNV) support in na_ontap_dns, ems_filter, export_policy(_rule), ldap_client and license.
questions: What is GCNV support in netapp.ontap?
